What can I say except that the veterinarians here are not only extremely competent, but also extraordinarily humane! Their professional skills, including those of the veterinary assistants, are beyond question, and, I repeat, their humanity towards the animals AND their owner(s) is truly exceptional!!! Even in the most difficult moments, unfortunately...
I've tried others before, but this one is unmatched!!!
I have complete confidence in them; I love my animals more than anything.
Even considering the quality/price ratio, I highly recommend them!!!

I just wanted to update my review regarding the passing, several months ago now, of Dr. Mical.

I will always remember his humor, his competence, and his self-deprecating humor: "I'm a veterinarian, but I never understood why my dog ​​(one in particular) ate gravel!" An epic moment! ;)
My thoughts are with his family, and as for him, extraordinary as he was, the "new generation" is in good hands! <3 I just had to write this...

(July 2026) Thank you so much for saving our beloved Sapphire! <3

Alicia Pion

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Gaugy. She successfully removed a skin growth on my Yorkshire Terrier and gave him a thorough teeth cleaning. She is a very competent and caring veterinarian. I highly recommend her clinic.

I sincerely thank the veterinarians and veterinary assistants for everything they did for Ficelle. Despite her passing, I will always remember their kindness, their availability, their attentiveness, and above all, their love for animals. You can tell they are passionate about their work and that they do everything they can to support the animals and their families with great compassion.

Thank you for everything you did for Ficelle and for being so gentle with her until the very end. ❤️🐾 I highly recommend this clinic.

I'm updating my review following the clinic's response, as it seems some clarification is needed:
I adopted my dog ​​from a shelter a little over a year ago. She had been spayed before being put up for adoption, as is always the case. Since the adoption, she had been seen by a veterinarian who treated recurring cystitis. It never seemed to get better. I then moved, so I no longer had a vet. While my parents were looking after my dog ​​for a few days, they took her to the Trion clinic because she was showing the same symptoms as usual (she was licking herself excessively, had a peculiar odor, and was hiding under my desk). At the clinic, they prescribed antibiotics and a small bottle of herbal medicine, the price of which I don't recall. This was the first step, to see if it would resolve the problem or at least provide some slight improvement. At the end of the treatment, my dog ​​wasn't getting any better, so I went back to the Trion clinic. She was examined, had an X-ray, etc. On the way there, I collected her urine to do the test the clinic mentioned in response to my comment. So, we went back to antibiotics, the X-ray showed nothing unusual, and they gave me a bottle of herbal medicine to prevent future cystitis, as well as recommending a change of food. There was a lot of pressure at reception for me to buy the bottle, which was supposedly €50 for a month's supply (it only lasted me two weeks, even following the recommended dosage). They were playing on my emotions at that point, and I got the impression that herbal medicine was a significant part of their business (they had many books and diplomas on aromatherapy and herbal medicine. The receptionist even told me that many of their clients came for that). I didn't have a problem with that in principle, but I felt pressured because if I didn't take it and my dog ​​was still sick afterward, it would have been because I'd been quibbling over €50.
At the end of the treatment, seeing no improvement, I called the clinic again, and they told me to change her food because "it makes a big difference." They didn't offer any other solutions, nothing. My dog ​​must have had a serious problem since she had very smelly discharge. My mother then reminded me that the Maison Alfort Veterinary Clinic had worked wonders for their animals. That's why I went there, after all those failed treatments and my loss of faith in the local vets. I was starting to get really worried about my dog ​​after several months of searching and unsuccessful treatments. There, they discovered that my dog ​​had a huge abscess in her abdomen caused by a forgotten gauze pad. It's the fault of the veterinarians who operated on her to spay her even before she was adopted. I never said it was the fault of the Trion clinic. What I blame them for is not seeing the mass in her abdomen, neither on the ultrasound nor during palpation, and for leaving me in the lurch with my sick dog after only two attempts. Without that consultation at the Maison Alfort Veterinary School, my dog ​​would have died of septicemia, as the bacteria in the abscess were resistant to antibiotics. I'm angry because my dog ​​could have been treated earlier and better. And because she was sick for far too long, which could have been avoided. I also incurred considerable expenses for treatments that weren't the right ones. I felt like I was only there to pay and that my dog ​​didn't receive proper follow-up care at that clinic. You should have tried again or told me you didn't know and directed me to the specialists you mentioned in the comments. To me, that's at least negligence. I'm sorry my previous comment seemed harsh, but the core issue remains the same based on my experience.

Hello, as the owner of a cat and a dog, I highly recommend this clinic! Whether it's the assistants or the veterinarians, they are very pleasant (both on the phone and during consultations), and they do their best to schedule appointments as soon as possible!

I contacted this clinic several weeks ago to make an appointment for my dog. I took the time to explain in detail all the symptoms she was exhibiting, but I was told it wasn't an emergency.

Faced with her worsening condition, I finally had to go to the emergency veterinary clinic. The verdict: poisoning. Luckily, I didn't follow the advice I was given, because the consequences could have been much more serious.

I also want to highlight the receptionist's behavior. Even though our conversation was quite brief, it was enough to demonstrate a real lack of politeness, kindness, and empathy. When you call because your pet isn't well, you expect to be greeted with at least a minimum of attentiveness and consideration.

I am deeply disappointed by this experience. A better assessment of emergency situations and a more humane approach are truly necessary.

I made an appointment for my Cavalier King Charles on Friday for Monday. I wanted to cancel the appointment this morning, but they don't open until 8:30 am, and my appointment was at 8:30 am. They don't even have an answering machine to cancel appointments. The receptionist called me, but the way she speaks to customers is awful. They're going to lose a lot of clients if they keep talking like that. As for me, I'm changing vets.

My cat had been very sick for a while, and I had to make the difficult decision to have her put down, so I called to make an appointment. The person on the phone told me to come that same day, which I did. When I arrived, she told me I'd made a mistake, that she never told me to come that day but the following day. I was very disappointed and shocked to find that, despite her mistake on the phone, she blamed me, saying I was wrong. Honestly, I'm talking about the end of a suffering animal's life here. The person told me to come that same day but refused to do what was necessary! I've been devastated ever since because making the decision to have your pet put down is never easy, but on top of that, the person on the phone and at reception refuses to take responsibility. It makes me furious! Extremely disappointed and I've lost all trust!
Excellent professionals, incredibly available, who agreed to see my cat as an emergency case for suspected chocolate poisoning. I highly recommend them!
A good clinic with very attentive medical staff. Appointments are always on time, no waiting.
Excellent clinic where professionalism meets kindness!

Hello,
As you are not registered in our files, we do not understand this review of our organization.

Sincerely,
DV Taveau

My cat and rabbit are patients at this clinic, which I highly recommend. The vet takes the time to review their records before each visit; she's gentle and handles the animals with care. I had my cat neutered there, and everything went perfectly. The assistants are also very professional.

I've been to this veterinary clinic several times over the years and have had the opportunity to meet everyone there. The assistants are kind and welcoming; I've always been well received and found their advice helpful. As for the veterinarians, they are also very gentle with my cats and highly professional; I trust them completely.
The reception and the vet were excellent, gentle and kind, I highly recommend them.
Always available and a very friendly vet

I went to the Trion clinic yesterday for the first time to get my cat's booster vaccinations. Dr. Taveau was extremely kind, attentive, and offered relevant advice. She took her time with my cat and with us. I will definitely return for future appointments. A special thank you for being open on Saturday mornings; it's very much appreciated when you can't make it during the week. I highly recommend them.
I do not recommend them due to a lack of professionalism. If you want to see your animals alive again, absolutely do not go there. I strongly advise against it.
AVOID AT ALL COSTS! They killed 2 cats!
Avoid at all costs ⚠️

Horrible! Don't go there if you don't want to find your cat dead. Don't go there!
It's a disgrace!
Don't bring your pets home #ripmotss

My cat was in perfect health, never sick, well-groomed, always clean and well-fed.

I brought him to this office for a simple neutering, and a week later, he DIED.

I asked the vet if there was anything I needed to be careful about after the operation. She replied:
"No, everything's fine, there's nothing to do."

Result: no collar, no antibiotics, no post-operative advice, nothing.

A week later, my cat became apathetic, stopped eating or drinking, lay prostrate all day, and then hid.

We went back to the clinic urgently, and they told us he had caught typhus, that it had become infected at the wound, and that "he should have been vaccinated beforehand."

But why didn't they tell us before the operation? Why not warn us that there was a risk of contamination or that a vaccine was recommended?

And the worst part... instead of taking responsibility, we're told it might be our fault, that we could have brought the virus home on our shoes.

Seriously? Is that the explanation?

And when we persisted, the vet finally told us:
"Yes, we have a lot of cases of typhus in the clinic right now."

So you KNEW your facility was at risk, and you let an unvaccinated cat in without warning us, without doing anything to protect it, and you want to blame the owners?

No. It's not our fault. You're the ones who did your job poorly, you're the ones who lacked professionalism, you're the ones who put my pet in danger.

Today my cat died, even though I did exactly what I was told to do.

And you take no responsibility, not a word of apology, not an acknowledgment of error. Just denial.

This kind of behavior is irresponsible and dangerous. You don't deserve people's trust.

Avoid this office if you care about your pet.

A fantastic clinic where the animals are very well cared for!
A wonderful welcome, thank you to the whole team (my little guy is even thrilled to come back when he understands we're going to the vet!).

If you have a pet and want it well cared for, get to know Dr. Taveau.

In 4 years, nothing but good results and a smile.

(I'm not being paid to tell the truth.)
Animal and Human Reception 👍 …
The veterinarian Cyrielle is very friendly and humane, which was not the case with her predecessors.
We appreciated the way he took care of our dog; the vet was very kind.

Unfortunately, I'm forced to give one star because zero stars isn't an option.
Avoid at all costs!!!! The vet and his assistant (if you can even call her that) were both extremely aggressive on the phone over a matter of "I couldn't cancel the appointment on their website."
On top of that, they charged €20 because the appointment wasn't canceled in time.

Frankly, it's a complete joke, both of them incredibly rude. The service is truly pathetic.

I'm delighted with this veterinary clinic!

The veterinary assistants are welcoming and friendly; as for Dr. Cyrielle Taveau, she has always demonstrated great professionalism, compassion, and availability with my young chow-chow, Google.

If you're looking for a veterinary clinic in Lyon, you'll definitely find excellent service and staff here.

PS: There's even free parking for clients, which is very convenient.
Thank you, Dr. Taveau, for taking such compassionate and kind care of Adélaïde at the end of her life. Thanks to you, this moment was less difficult. Thank you again!
A veterinarian who listens and is there to take care of our cat

This is my second visit, the first for one cat and the second for my two cats. The welcome, the quality of the veterinary assistants and veterinarians, the care provided, and especially the attention given to my animals were simply exceptional. I highly recommend them. Professionals at reasonable prices, not exorbitant like I've seen elsewhere.
My partner and I were very satisfied. Thank you :)

⚠️ A clinic to avoid!! ⚠️
They give incorrect information about the validity period of vaccines, complain, and cancel appointments with a 5-minute delay. Their main motivation is to take your money.

I went back for deworming the other day, and they told me a consultation was necessary and that they might refuse me an appointment because I was 5 minutes late 6 months ago. I said goodbye. It's a shame they're losing 3 follow-up appointments for animals. 💸
Great team, professional and friendly. I recommend them!

Friendly reception at the clinic and competent vets.
I've been taking my cats there for years.
Excellent vet, very attentive and they are super friendly. First time we went there, impeccable! 👍👍👍👍👍 …
Really easy to get our dog’s passport endorsed for return to Ireland. Knew exactly what was needed and managed the technical language for me.
